# discord_application_settings (Resource)

Manages the settings of the application the provider's bot token belongs to, as on the Developer Portal. There is one per bot token. Settings omitted from configuration are left unmanaged; set a URL or `description` to `""` to clear it. Destroying the resource only removes it from Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_application_settings" "this" {
  description = "Moderation and welcome messages for our community."
  tags        = ["moderation", "utility"]

  integration_types_config = {
    guild_install = {
      scopes      = ["applications.commands", "bot"]
      permissions = provider::discord::permissions(["SEND_MESSAGES", "MANAGE_MESSAGES"])
    }
    user_install = {}
  }

  role_connections_verification_url = "https://example.com/discord/linked-roles"
  gateway_message_content_limited   = true

  icon_wo         = "data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("${path.module}/icon.png")}"
  icon_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `cover_image` (String) Application cover image as a data URI, e.g. `"data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("cover_image.png")}"`. Shown as the default rich presence invite cover. Stored in state; prefer `cover_image_wo` on Terraform 1.11 or later. Removing the attribute leaves the current cover image in place.
- `cover_image_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Application cover image as a data URI. Shown as the default rich presence invite cover. Write-only: the value is never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later and `cover_image_wo_version`. Conflicts with `cover_image`.
- `cover_image_wo_version` (Number) Version of `cover_image_wo`. Setting or changing it uploads `cover_image_wo`; removing it leaves the current cover image in place.
- `custom_install_url` (String) Custom URL of the application's install link, used in place of the link Discord provides. Set to `""` to clear the setting; omit to leave it unmanaged.
- `description` (String) Description of the application, at most 400 characters. Set to `""` to clear it.
- `event_webhooks_status` (String) Whether webhook events are sent: `disabled` or `enabled`. Discord reports `disabled_by_discord` when it has turned them off, usually after the URL stopped responding.
- `event_webhooks_types` (Set of String) Webhook event types to receive, e.g. `APPLICATION_AUTHORIZED`.
- `event_webhooks_url` (String) URL that receives webhook events. Set to `""` to clear the setting; omit to leave it unmanaged.
- `gateway_guild_members_limited` (Boolean) Whether the `GATEWAY_GUILD_MEMBERS_LIMITED` intent, flag `32768`, is enabled. It is the intent for bots in fewer than 100 servers; larger bots need Discord's approval. Omit to leave unmanaged.
- `gateway_message_content_limited` (Boolean) Whether the `GATEWAY_MESSAGE_CONTENT_LIMITED` intent, flag `524288`, is enabled. It is the intent for bots in fewer than 100 servers; larger bots need Discord's approval. Omit to leave unmanaged.
- `gateway_presence_limited` (Boolean) Whether the `GATEWAY_PRESENCE_LIMITED` intent, flag `8192`, is enabled. It is the intent for bots in fewer than 100 servers; larger bots need Discord's approval. Omit to leave unmanaged.
- `icon` (String) Application icon as a data URI, e.g. `"data:image/png;base64,${filebase64("icon.png")}"`. Stored in state; prefer `icon_wo` on Terraform 1.11 or later. Removing the attribute leaves the current icon in place.
- `icon_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Application icon as a data URI. Write-only: the value is never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later and `icon_wo_version`. Conflicts with `icon`.
- `icon_wo_version` (Number) Version of `icon_wo`. Setting or changing it uploads `icon_wo`; removing it leaves the current icon in place.
- `install_params` (Attributes) Scopes and permissions of the install link Discord provides. Superseded by `integration_types_config` for applications that support user installs. Managed only while set; removing it leaves the current setting in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--install_params))
- `integration_types_config` (Attributes Map) The installation contexts the application supports, keyed by `guild_install`, `user_install`, each with the scopes and permissions of its install link. An empty object, `{}`, supports the context without an install link. Managed only while set; removing it leaves the current setting in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integration_types_config))
- `interactions_endpoint_url` (String) URL that receives interactions over HTTP instead of the gateway. Discord sends it a test request when it is saved and rejects the URL unless it responds correctly. Set to `""` to clear the setting; omit to leave it unmanaged.
- `role_connections_verification_url` (String) URL users visit to link their account for linked roles; see `discord_application_role_connection_metadata`. Set to `""` to clear the setting; omit to leave it unmanaged.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags describing the application's content and functionality: at most 5, of 1-20 characters each.

### Read-Only

- `cover_image_hash` (String) Hash of the current cover image. Discord only returns this hash, so a change made outside Terraform makes the next plan upload the configured cover image again.
- `flags` (Number) The application's public flags bitfield. Of these, Discord only lets bots change the limited intents, each with its own argument.
- `icon_hash` (String) Hash of the current icon. Discord only returns this hash, so a change made outside Terraform makes the next plan upload the configured icon again.
- `id` (String) ID of the application.
- `name` (String) Name of the application. Discord does not let bots change it.

<a id="nestedatt--install_params"></a>
### Nested Schema for `install_params`

Required:

- `permissions` (String) Permissions to request for the bot role, as a decimal bitfield, e.g. from `provider::discord::permissions()`. Only used with the `bot` scope.
- `scopes` (Set of String) OAuth2 scopes to add the application with: `applications.commands`, `bot` or both.


<a id="nestedatt--integration_types_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integration_types_config`

Optional:

- `permissions` (String) Permissions to request for the bot role, as a decimal bitfield, e.g. from `provider::discord::permissions()`. Only used with the `bot` scope. Requires `scopes`.
- `scopes` (Set of String) OAuth2 scopes to add the application with: `applications.commands`, `bot` or both. Requires `permissions`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_application_settings.this
  identity = {
    application_id = "456789012345678901"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `application_id` (String) ID of the application.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_application_settings.this <application_id>
```
